name: OCEL/OCPN Replay
description: Replays every timestamped OCEL event against a selected Object-Centric Petri Net using a deterministic object-bound token game. Produces source-bound event support, log/model moves, and replayed-event interaction fields for Interaction Atlas.

maxEvents.title: Maximum events
maxEvents.description: Safety ceiling for a complete replay. The action stops rather than producing evidence for only a prefix; raise it above the source event count if necessary.

maxSilentMoves.title: Silent-move bound
maxSilentMoves.description: Maximum silent transitions explored per object binding while enabling an observed activity. It bounds search without changing event order.

binCount.title: Interaction-field bins
binCount.description: Resolution of the replayed-event expected interaction fields. Choose the same value in Interaction Atlas to inspect residuals.

traceLimit.title: Animation frames
traceLimit.description: Events kept as a step-by-step firing trace for the Replay animation view. The token game replays these deterministically, so no marking snapshots are stored. 0 disables the trace; large values inflate the artifact, which is kept in memory only below 2 MB.

author: Promenade Team
